verdict.rationale: Event-triggered actions come only from adjacent Claude Code features, not Skills itself: plugins can bundle hooks alongside skills (docs-6, docs-70), and SDK hooks can block dangerous operations before they execute (docs-91). Skills' own triggering is a semantic description match (docs-3, docs-17, docs-25), not a deterministic event rule, and users report it is unreliable: skills were never invoked in 56% of Vercel's evals, and users often must invoke them explicitly (comm-12, comm-13, comm-14). missing for 10: documented event types and rule/condition syntax for hooks, deterministic event-to-action configuration within Skills itself, hands-on corroboration that event rules fire reliably.
